apworld_0.3.0.description:
Note:
Is not compatible with any ongoing archipelago runs that use the old apworld.

GOLD REWORK:
There is now a new item "Magic Wallet" that functionally divides the store in different tiers.
Every new wallet unlocks 2 locations, except the final one only unlocking 1.
There are currently 7 wallets in the pool, needing 5 to unlock the final tier.
This approach makes it so that:
There are no grinding for gold at all.
You can always access the location if you have the correct amount of wallets, you can never "buy the wrong location" and not be able
to buy the other ones.
Now the gold that all the pots give in vanilla does not actually give you gold in addition to the sent location.

XP REWORK:
Xp from XP items are now added to a pool, instead of given directly to you when you obtain them.
Then the game will set your XP (and level you up automatically), if your XP is ever below that pool.
Exception being if you are in a boss room or the room before the boss room, since I want you to have the choice to use Brocia Serum to either level up to the boss level (to prevent grinding), or level down to the boss level (to get the intended challenge), leaving these rooms will fix your level to what you where before entering these rooms.
Known Issue:
Teleporting between these rooms will let you keep the Recommended boss level from one boss to another, but I think that is fine since Brocia Serum is a choice anyways.

Note: 
The game uses a somewhat generic function to recalculate your level and actually level you up.
The simplest way to force this function is to open the inventory.
It should also trigger upon most room transitions, defeating an enemy, teleporting (possibly more). 

OTHER:
Added a simple option for changing Filler to Traps.

Ai disclaimer this release: https://github.com/polkagrisar/YsFelghana-AP/commit/0493893963fddadb16b1175ee5ca3a6cb83244c7
1. Helped fix error in Memory.py Lines 915-916 -> 970-971.
2. Helped finding the silent crash I caused in game_watcher_loop in Client.py Lines 453-462
